name: Preroll Scheduler
author: Thunderhat
description: Simple cinema prerolls from media buckets and date-range schedules. Keeps the next preroll ready in Plex ahead of each movie.

settingsSchema.label: Toolkit folder prefix
settingsSchema.help: Optional. Path prefix as seen inside Plex Toolkit (e.g. /prerolls). Leave blank when Toolkit and Plex share the same paths.

settingsSchema.label: Plex folder prefix
settingsSchema.help: Optional. Same folder as seen by Plex Media Server (e.g. D:\Plex\prerolls).
